# Vendors

The **Vendors** page allows you to manage all the suppliers your organization works with.  
A **vendor** is any company or individual that provides materials, products, or services to your organization — for example, raw material suppliers, part manufacturers, or service providers.

Managing vendors in one place helps ensure **better purchasing control, payment tracking, and performance monitoring** across all your supply chain activities.

---

## Why We Need Vendors

- Vendors are the **source of goods and services** required for manufacturing or operations.
- Maintaining vendor data helps in:
  - Streamlining the **purchase order** process.
  - Tracking **payment terms and delivery performance**.
  - Ensuring **reliable and timely supplies**.
  - Maintaining **transparency and accountability** in procurement.

Having a dedicated vendor management page allows you to **view, edit, and monitor** vendor details efficiently without switching between multiple tools.

---

## Page Overview

- **Tabs** → Navigate between **All**, **Vendors**, **Partners**, and **Customers**.
- **+ Add New Button** → Add a new company, vendor, partner, or customer depending on the selected tab.
- **Table View** → Displays all vendors with important details like code, name, payment terms, website, and performance stats.
- **Drawer Panels** → Open when creating or editing a vendor to view full details in a structured form.

---

## Table Columns

| Column                   | Description                                                                          |
| ------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| **Vendor Code**          | Unique code for each vendor. Click to edit details if you have permission.           |
| **Name**                 | The official name of the vendor company.                                             |
| **Category**             | Classifies the type of vendor (e.g., Raw Material Supplier, Service Provider).       |
| **Payment Terms**        | Displays the credit or payment terms agreed with the vendor (e.g., Net 30, Advance). |
| **Website**              | Link to the vendor’s official website. Click to open in a new tab.                   |
| **Email**                | The vendor’s primary contact email.                                                  |
| **Currency**             | Shows the transaction currency used with the vendor.                                 |
| **Total Orders**         | Number of purchase orders created for this vendor.                                   |
| **Total Spent**          | Total amount spent with this vendor.                                                 |
| **On-Time Delivery (%)** | Vendor’s delivery performance rate, helping evaluate reliability.                    |

---

## Actions You Can Perform

### 1. Add a New Vendor

- Click **+ Add New**.
- Fill in vendor details such as name, category, contact info, payment terms, and currency.
- Save the record to make it available in the vendor list.

### 2. Edit Vendor Information

- Click on a vendor code (if you have modify permission).
- Update vendor details such as payment terms, contact information, or website.
- Save the changes to keep vendor data up to date.

### 3. View Vendor Details

- Open a vendor entry to review full information, including past orders and performance statistics.
- Use this to monitor vendor reliability and relationship history.

---

## Permissions and Access

- Users can view or edit data based on assigned permissions.
- If you don’t have modify access, the system will notify you that editing is restricted.
- This ensures that **only authorized users** can create or update vendor information.

---

## Notifications

You’ll receive **real-time alerts** for your actions:

- ✅ Success when a vendor is created or updated.
- ⚠️ Warnings if you don’t have permission for an action.
- ❌ Error messages if data fetching fails.

---

## Example Workflow

1. Go to the **Vendors** tab.
2. Click **+ Add New** to register a new vendor.
3. Fill in required fields like name, email, and payment terms.
4. Save the record — the vendor now appears in the vendor list.
5. If needed, edit vendor information or monitor their performance metrics.

---

By using the **Vendors** page, you can maintain a clean and accurate database of all supplier relationships, ensuring smooth procurement, on-time deliveries, and improved vendor performance visibility across your organization.
